name: corpus.heldout2
description: SECOND held-out generalization corpus. corpus.heldout.json is BURNED — four precision rules were written against the four failures it produced, so re-scoring it is in-sample and cannot measure generalization. This set was selected on 2026-08-19 from PUBLIC METADATA ONLY (stars, age, activity, language, size, description); NittiM's scanners were NOT run against any candidate before freezing, and no repo was included or excluded on the basis of what NittiM does to it.
metric: Ideal verdict is production_ready or ready_with_conditions; ideal critical-finding count is 0. Free-tier secret-scanner FCR = repos whose only hard evidence is a committed-secret hit.

predicates.C2: first public release >= 4 years before construction — all created before 2022-08-19
predicates.C3: last commit within 12 months — all pushed after 2025-11-19
predicates.C4: RESTATED 2026-08-19. Original wording ('zero open critical/high CVEs via osv-scanner over each manifest') is not evaluable for libraries that ship no lockfile — which is most libraries — and it conflates dev tooling with shipped risk. Restated: no open CRITICAL/HIGH advisory in the RUNTIME dependency set, at the pinned lockfile where one exists; 'n/a_no_lockfile' recorded explicitly where none exists; 'dev_only_advisory' recorded where advisories are confined to dev/test/tooling manifests. A dev-only advisory does NOT fail admission, deliberately: it cannot be a true production risk, so it cannot cause the true-positive/false-positive conflation C4 exists to prevent — and it is the exact condition that exposed the encode/httpx dev-vs-runtime misclassification in heldout1. Excluding those repos would hide the defect class.
predicates.C5: RESTATED 2026-08-19. Original required NittiM's own scanner AND Gitleaks to report zero secrets. As an ADMISSION FILTER that is circular: it excludes every repo NittiM false-positives on, which is the population an FCR benchmark measures, making the result 0% by construction. Restated: ground truth is established INDEPENDENTLY (Gitleaks 8.30.1 plus manual adjudication of every hit); NittiM's output is the MEASUREMENT and never the gate. Two repos carry adjudicated non-secret hits and were deliberately KEPT.
predicates.C6: library, framework, or CLI — no web applications
predicates.C7: language in {JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust}

composition.star_bands: 6.8k–29k, deliberately spread — a first pass drew entirely from 23–30k, which would sample only the most-reviewed code and understate FCR
composition.overlap_with_prior_corpora: none — checked against all 88 repos across every existing corpus

disclosed_exclusions: gitleaks/gitleaks and trufflesecurity/trufflehog qualify on every predicate and were EXCLUDED. Their repositories are built of deliberate credential-shaped fixtures, so including them would near-guarantee secret-scanner false positives — stacking the deck rather than measuring. Recorded here because excluding them silently would be cherry-picking in NittiM's favour.
pallets/*, sindresorhus/*, tokio-rs/* candidates were skipped: those clusters are already named concentration biases or appear in the burned corpus.
